//: Model tiering. The gateway routes workloads by 'tier'. v1 can ship with just the 'default' 20B.

default.notes: MoE, 3.6B active/token, native MXFP4 ~14GB. Four layers are explicitly offloaded to the 4 GB RTX A500, leaving headroom for CUDA buffers; the remaining weights stay in system RAM.

fast.//: Optional small model for the many-small-requests classification/extraction path.
fast.notes: Used for high-count per-row classification/extraction when routed by tier: 'fast'. The VRAM value is advisory because Ollama can offload to system RAM/CPU.
